answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claims one slot by burning a $25 deposit, like a ticket to a small island: one seat per ticket. At dawn the registry lists slots; a hollow identity cannot reuse a burned slot, since receipts are bound to keys. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000, but the epoch pool pays only $3,000, so the attack loses $22,000 upfront. An honest agent burns $25 once and keeps its full share.
